findings.highlight: go report this to Ensemble's chief editor first
findings.evidenceJa: 「とにかくアンサンブルの編集長には報告しとく。向こうはまだ冬馬曜子と連絡取れないらしくて」
findings.explanation: Hamada says he will report the injury to Ensemble's chief editor, since Ensemble still cannot reach Youko. The English orders Haruki to go make the report, reversing responsibility for the sensitive publisher-to-publisher disclosure.
findings.japanese:
「とにかくアンサンブルの編集長には報告しとく。
向こうはまだ冬馬曜子と連絡取れないらしくて」
findings.todokanai: "Anyway, go report this to Ensemble's chief editor first. It seems they couldn't get in touch with Touma Youko either."

findings.highlight: this is the third day in a row I'm eating curry
findings.evidenceJa: …なんて、三日も煮込んだカレーにそこまで刺激的な香りは期待できないけど。
findings.explanation: The curry has been simmering for three days, so Haruki cannot expect its aroma to remain sharply spicy. The English says he has eaten curry three days in a row and therefore cannot get excited, changing the cooking fact that later explains its mild, stale smell.
findings.japanese:
…なんて、三日も煮込んだカレーに
そこまで刺激的な香りは期待できないけど。
findings.todokanai: …Of course, this is the third day in a row I'm eating curry, so I can't bring myself to get excited about the stimulating fragrance.

findings.highlight: It's been an hour since I left Kazusa's room as she was muttering in sadness.
findings.evidenceJa:
かずさの、突き刺さるような哀しい呟きに背中を押され、
部屋を後にしたのは一時間前のこと。
findings.explanation: Kazusa's piercingly sad mutter drives Haruki out of the room; the English merely says he left while she was muttering — The one-hour separation and her painful rejection remain intact.
findings.japanese:
かずさの、突き刺さるような哀しい呟きに背中を押され、
部屋を後にしたのは一時間前のこと。
findings.todokanai: It's been an hour since I left Kazusa's room as she was muttering in sadness.

findings.highlight: that decision ended up being completely unsuccessful
findings.evidenceJa: 「さっきカレーを一人で食べようとして、その行為を全否定されたからだ」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she tried to eat the curry alone and Haruki completely condemned that action; she is now perversely obeying his prohibition on using either hand. The English says only that her attempt was unsuccessful, erasing the interpersonal logic behind her demand to be fed.
findings.japanese:
「さっきカレーを一人で食べようとして、
その行為を全否定されたからだ」
findings.todokanai: "Just earlier I was trying to eat curry by myself, and that decision ended up being completely unsuccessful."

findings.highlight: I've only bothered to write about how I don't want to talk to Setsuna.
findings.evidenceJa: 途中の経緯を省き過ぎてる。しかも、雪菜に話したくないことだけを選んで。
findings.explanation: Haruki realizes he has omitted far too much of what happened, selectively excluding precisely the things he does not want to tell Setsuna. The English instead says he wrote about not wanting to talk to her, reversing concealment into disclosure and making his critique of the email incoherent.
findings.japanese:
途中の経緯を省き過ぎてる。
しかも、雪菜に話したくないことだけを選んで。
findings.todokanai: The details are far too lacking. And I've only bothered to write about how I don't want to talk to Setsuna.
